ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_LNS
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability
AS(
	SELECT 
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BLG.LCHG_TIME AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
	,BLG.LIMIT_B2KID AS LimitB2KId
	,BLG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLGD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST_DELTA BLGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLGD.ACID = BLG.ACID AND BLGD.BANK_ID = BLG.BANK_ID AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PeriodStartTimestamp, LimitB2KId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PeriodStartTimestamp, LimitB2KId
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
	,ISNULL(SRC.LimitB2KId,TGT.LimitB2KId) AS LimitB2KId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp
AND SRC.LimitB2KId = TGT.LimitB2KId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = TGT.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
     AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
     AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp
     AND DELTA.LimitB2KId = TGT.LimitB2KId
     AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability SRC ON SRC.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = TGT.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
     AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
     AND SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp = TGT.PeriodStartTimestamp
     AND SRC.LimitB2KId = TGT.LimitB2KId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.LimitB2KId AS LimitB2KId
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = SRC.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
     AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
     AND DELTA.PeriodStartTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
     AND DELTA.LimitB2KId = SRC.LimitB2KId
     AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,LimitB2KId AS LimitB2KId
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountRelatedLimitLiability_DELTA;

END
